items.boundary: Default four-role developer bootstrap, attributed explicit lesson decisions, and executable version-bound gate across actual CLI/MCP and PostgreSQL; synthetic approvals only.
Actual work-packet validation plus positive/negative contract fixtures.
Live local adapters exercise source/validation/projection eligibility, recovery and hydration in disposable services.
Owned trace and immutable evidence; external unobserved actions remain outside trace coverage.
All six test definitions and fixed metric queries; publication of real definitions requires its own decision.
Complete two-task synthetic transition and reuse path.

Actual pilot executable exercises malformed output, unchanged repair failure, deterministic recount, stale revision denial and successful Task B revision with retained exact artifacts. Protocol outputs are synthetic; real-model evidence remains in the retained pilot.
Actual local verifier and behavior checks with deterministic patch fixtures; actual local-model quality is evidenced by the retained pilot, not these tests.
Synthetic identity exercises exact approval. Existing real Task A approval is documented separately; test execution grants no real approval.
Actual worker publication and exact Milvus read-back; historical real-pilot publication remains separately recorded.

Actual pilot executable completes retrieval, explicit use, failed Task B output and version-2 local revision without publishing Task B. Generated answers are deterministic fixtures; real-model quality is evidenced separately.
Real-pilot definitions remain pending exact-version human decisions; synthetic query success does not close L12.
Self-provisioning isolated suite must execute all mapped checks; missing/skipped required tests fail the report.
Migration/legacy-evidence regression and actual admin migration; protected local dump restore is separately documented, not rerun against live data.
Matching built gateway/worker/admin and real policies start successfully in the disposable stack; no live cutover claimed.
Actual worker durable queue and actual local collector accept receipts.
Mapped automated suite supplements required make check and documentation review; this is not a production readiness assertion.
Disposable activation rehearsal only. Live activation remains blocked on the existing encrypted vault unlock and actual cutover checks.
Actual CLI task issuance and HTTP revocation plus service expiry/live-authority cases; enterprise federation remains outside local certification.
Tests existing mandatory authority gates only. Representative 7/14-day cohorts and accountable stage adoption cannot be replaced by synthetic tests.
Pending/raw access, validated publication and current eligible retrieval are exercised over MCP.
Current applicable curation mechanism captures a pending lesson after reuse. Warehouse applicability remains the documented scoped decision.
Exact-version duplicate inspection and foreign/quarantined exclusions with authoritative candidates; OCR/PDF and production corpus recall are outside supported scope.
Executable stale-definition withdrawal and owner-attributed synthetic decisions; named deployment ownership and acceptance remain unspecified.
Local review/hold, immutable storage and collector export only. Production archival, hold authority and deletion requirements remain unspecified.
Project isolation and configuration denials are local regression evidence. Target identity, cluster, storage and measured availability/recovery are still required.
Local source/verifier regressions supplement the retained rendered-overlay/read-only mount receipt; this run does not deploy Kubernetes.
Coverage loader requires all checklist IDs exactly once. Manual/production evidence limits are explicit per row.
